step: step 6 - determine each relation as IDENTICAL, DISTINCT or IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED under the governing identity standard
governing_identity_standard_unchanged: IDENTICAL_PROVISION_AND_VERSION only where the two rows agree on every recorded identity field (instrument title, provision descriptor, official locator, jurisdiction reference, record type) and record no conflicting value for any shared effective-information key; DISTINCT_PROVISION_OR_VERSION where the recorded instrument, provision descriptor or authority differs; IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED where the recorded descriptors are neither identical nor distinct (PHASE5-001L, preserved). This order applies that standard with first-hand source text added; it amends nothing.
determinations_added_by_this_order: every one of the twenty-five unresolved relation records now carries a determination, recorded here as this order's findings. Nothing is written into SOURCE_CAPTURES/PHASE5-001L, the register or the catalogue; the proposed ledger of step 7 is the only artifact that carries them forward and it is not applied.
